description:
Site: crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:528 (JmapBackend trait) + crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs (handle_get, handle_changes, handle_query, handle_query_changes).

Foundation slice of the JMAP-g7wu.1 mega-PR. Continues the work of JMAP-g7wu.1.4 (which got ctx to the closure boundary) by pushing ctx through the closure into the handler call sites and into the JmapBackend trait itself.

Design locked under JMAP-g7wu.1.1 [2026-05-11 design-lock] comment. Specific scope for this foundation bead:

1. Add 'type CallerCtx: Clone + Send + 'static;' associated type to JmapBackend trait.
2. Add 'caller: &Self::CallerCtx' as first parameter (after &self) to every JmapBackend method:
   - account_exists
   - get_objects
   - get_state
   - get_changes
   - query_objects
   - query_changes
3. Update generic read-side helpers in crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs:
   - handle_get<B, O>(backend: &B, caller: &B::CallerCtx, args: Value) -> ...
   - handle_changes<B, O>(...)
   - handle_query<B, O>(...)
   - handle_query_changes<B, O>(...)
4. Update Dispatcher tests in crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs (closure_handler_forwards_caller etc.) to exercise the new ctx-aware paths.
5. README rewrites where applicable in crate-jmap-server/README.md.

Trait shape:
    pub trait JmapBackend: Send + Sync + 'static {
        type Error: std::error::Error + Send + Sync + 'static;
        type CallerCtx: Clone + Send + 'static;
        fn get_objects<O: GetObject + Send + Sync>(
            &self,
            caller: &Self::CallerCtx,
            account_id: &Id,
            ids: Option<&[Id]>,
            properties: Option<&[String]>,
        ) -> impl Future<...> + Send;
        // ...
    }

This bead must land first or co-land with JMAP-g7wu.1.1 because all extension *Backend traits inherit from JmapBackend. Per the design-lock decision (Q5 sub-decision 5c), all 8 beads (.1.1 mail canonical, .1.2 contacts, .1.3 sharing, .1.5 chat, .1.6 calendars, .1.7 tasks, .1.8 filenode, and this foundation bead) land atomically in one mega-PR.

Rides JMAP-g7wu.1's 0.2.0 mega-PR alongside JMAP-r3pg.14 (extract_account_id clean fix).
notes: Starting work as part of coordinated mega-PR with .1.1 canonical + 6 propagation siblings + JMAP-r3pg.14 extract_account_id reshape
